answer: My answer to sybils is Attested record collector society membership with collectors society attestation — a membership the society kept across years of pressings — which makes the karst of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the bridge of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head. The anchor is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
